data.name: Dashvika
data.gender_notes: Dashvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dashvika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Dash’ meaning ten and ‘Vik’ meaning powers or steps. In Hindu mythology, Dashavatara refers to the ten avatars of Vishnu. Dashvika could be considered a feminine form of Dashavatara or a name for a girl with ten unique qualities or powers. The name Dashvika carries the meaning “Ten steps, ten powers” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dashvika usually hope their child will grow to embody ten steps, ten powers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and divine power
data.etymology: Dashvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ten steps, ten powers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dashvika total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
